verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI lets you set context length and GPU offload per model load and assign each load an identifier, which gives per-instance control over context allocation. However, the evidence never explicitly documents running several instances at once or managing how context memory is shared across them. missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrent multi-instance loading, cross-instance context/KV-cache memory allocation controls, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
